summary: Applies NVIDIA RTX Video SDK AI filters for video super-resolution, SDR-to-HDR conversion, or both in one TOP.

key_params.name: mode
key_params.note: Choose superres, sdrtohdr, or superreshdr processing.

key_params.name: superresquality
key_params.note: Bicubic, low, medium, high, or ultra VSR quality.

key_params.name: hdrmiddlegray
key_params.note: Average brightness target for generated HDR.

key_params.name: hdrmaxluminance
key_params.note: Peak luminance target in thousands of nits.

common_gotchas: Combined Super-Resolution + HDR mode is documented as higher-performance than chaining two nodes.
Ultra super-resolution is highest quality but slowest.
HDR modes need an HDR-aware downstream display/output path or the result can be misleading in SDR monitoring.
The implementation can be replaced by a custom operator build placed in the plugin directory.
key_concepts: Applies NVIDIA RTX Video SDK AI filters to video inputs.
Can run video super-resolution, SDR-to-HDR conversion, or both together.
Super-resolution quality is a performance/quality tradeoff from Bicubic through Ultra.
The official implementation can be replaced by placing a custom operator build in the plugin directory.
